title: Gentle Ben 2: Danger on the Mountain
overview: Tensions rise as Jack and Fog clash over drilling plans on Jack's land near a wilderness preserve. Fog surprises the town by announcing a natural spring water business instead. Jack, skeptical, is jailed for allegedly sabotaging Fog’s well. Ben and Mark discover Fog’s partners are hiding something, revealing the venture is more than Fog anticipated. It's a race to prove Jack’s innocence and uncover the truth before Mark is taken to a foster home.
